This is a lovely family-run restaurant. The food is simple and has that comforting homemade taste you don’t find everywhere.

featured_reviews.name: K. “ContentName” F.
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was introduced to this small, family-run Maharashtrian restaurant by a family member.  Seating is limited (2 tables, around 10 chairs). There is wash basin on site but no washroom.

The Baigan Bharta is their signature dish. Highly recommended. We tried a couple of their thaalis. Bhangda, Bombil, Chicken and Vegetarian.The highlight of the meal was the inclusion of kardi with all thalis, a unique touch that makes it worth it.

The portions are pretty good, making it easy to share a thali between two people (with a medium appetite).

UPDATE: The Gawar Bhaji was a gravy, which I didn't find appealing. I also found that it lacked  coconut. This dish didn't tick the box for me.

While the menu may seem limited to some, the quality of the food is exceptional. For dessert,  ice cream is available at MRP.

We visited this place twice so far.
